title: CASE: Confusion-Aware Skill Evolution for Frozen Multimodal Emotion Models
title_zh: CASE：面向冻结多模态情感模型的混淆感知技能演化

paragraphs.en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have substantially advanced Multimodal Emotion Recognition (MER) by enabling fine-grained emotion understanding through reasoning over multimodal evidence. However, they still exhibit systematic confusion between semantically adjacent emotions with highly overlapping multimodal cues. Existing approaches typically address these errors through global parameter adaptation, making confusion correction costly and inflexible. We instead observe that emotion confusion is highly localized and therefore better addressed through reusable pair-specific expertise. Building on this insight, we propose Confusion-Aware Skill Evolution (CASE), the first agent-skill framework for MER. CASE maintains a sparse, self-evolving library of pair-specific EmotionSkills that externalize affective expertise from model parameters, enabling the learned expertise to be continuously refined and readily transferred across diverse frozen MLLM backbones. During inference, CASE dynamically retrieves the appropriate EmotionSkill to reinforce boundary-aware reasoning while keeping the MLLM backbone frozen. Extensive experiments on CA-MER, DFEW, and EMER demonstrate the effectiveness and transferability of CASE across both general-purpose and emotion-specialized MLLMs. Notably, CASE improves the average accuracy of Qwen3-VL-8B on the CA-MER benchmark from 46.80% to 59.13%, while achieving consistent gains across MLLMs.

paragraphs.en: Recent advances in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown impressive performance on video-based Multimodal Emotion Recognition (MER). Beyond predicting emotion labels directly, MLLMs can integrate visual, temporal, and contextual evidence to provide interpretable explanations for their decisions, making them a promising foundation for grounded affective computing ( Lian et al. 2023 ; Cheng et al. 2024 ) .

paragraphs.en: Despite this progress, fine-grained emotion recognition remains a fundamental challenge. Although current MLLMs often identify the relevant affective evidence, they still struggle to distinguish semantically similar emotions, such as worry versus sadness or fear versus surprise ( Lian et al. 2025a ; Hu et al. 2025 ) . This limitation suggests that the bottleneck of modern MER has shifted from coarse affective perception to fine-grained boundary discrimination.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管取得了这些进展，细粒度情绪识别仍然是一项根本性挑战。 尽管当前的多模态大语言模型通常能够识别相关的情感证据，但它们仍难以区分语义相似的情绪，例如担忧与悲伤，或恐惧与惊讶（Lian 等，2025a；Hu 等，2025）。 这一局限表明，现代多模态情绪识别的瓶颈已经从粗粒度的情感感知转移到了细粒度的边界判别上。

paragraphs.en: More importantly, these misclassifications are not random prediction failures but exhibit a systematic structure. In psychological theories, emotions are characterized as a continuous affective space rather than isolated categories, where neighboring emotions naturally share semantic and behavioral characteristics ( Barrett et al. 2025 ; Plutchik 2001 ) . The psychological structure is also reflected in MER, where prediction errors consistently concentrate on neighboring emotion pairs rather than being uniformly distributed across the label space. The observed structured confusion pattern suggests that improving fine-grained MER requires more than stronger general reasoning; it calls for mechanisms that explicitly reinforce discriminative boundaries between systematically confused emotion pairs. Existing approaches, however, primarily rely on global parameter adaptation or task-specific fine-tuning, implicitly treating all emotion categories equally. As a result, they overlook the localized nature of emotion confusion and lack an effective mechanism for accumulating and reusing pair-specific affective expertise.
paragraphs.zh: 更重要的是，这些错误分类并非随机的预测失败，而是呈现出一种系统性结构。 在心理学理论中，情绪被刻画为一个连续的情感空间，而非孤立的类别，其中相邻的情绪天然地共享语义和行为特征（Barrett et al. 2025；Plutchik 2001）。 这种心理学结构同样体现在多标签情绪识别中，其预测误差持续集中在相邻的情绪对上，而不是均匀分布在标签空间中。 所观察到的结构化混淆模式表明，提升细粒度的多标签情绪识别不能仅依靠更强的通用推理能力，还需要能够显式强化系统性混淆情绪对之间判别边界的机制。 然而，现有方法主要依赖全局参数自适应或任务特定的微调，隐含地将所有情绪类别一视同仁。 因此，它们忽视了情绪混淆的局部性，也缺乏一种有效机制来积累和复用针对特定情绪对的情感专业知识。

paragraphs.en: Motivated by the systematic nature of emotion confusion, we propose Confusion-Aware Skill Evolution (CASE) , a general agent-skill framework that models fine-grained emotion recognition as a collection of pair-specific discrimination problems rather than a globally shared reasoning task. As shown in Figure 1 , CASE maintains a sparse, self-evolving library of EmotionSkills. Each EmotionSkill encapsulates the discriminative knowledge required to resolve one systematically confused adjacent emotion pair. Specifically, CASE localizes ambiguous predictions to candidate confusion pairs, evolves confusion-specific skills based on recoverable errors, and selectively expands the skill library only when recurrent confusion patterns emerge. During inference, the most relevant EmotionSkill is dynamically retrieved to reinforce boundary-aware reasoning while keeping the MLLM backbone frozen. In this way, CASE externalizes affective expertise into modular knowledge that evolves independently of model parameters and can be readily reused across diverse frozen MLLM backbones.
paragraphs.zh: 受情绪混淆系统性特征的启发，我们提出混淆感知技能演化（CASE），一个通用的智能体技能框架，它将细粒度情绪识别建模为一组针对特定情绪对的辨别问题，而非一个全局共享的推理任务。 如图 1 所示，CASE 维护一个稀疏的、自演化的情绪技能（EmotionSkills）库。 每个情绪技能封装了解决一个系统性混淆的相邻情绪对所需的辨别知识。 具体而言，CASE 将模糊的预测定位到候选混淆对，基于可恢复的错误演化针对特定混淆的技能，并且仅在反复出现的混淆模式出现时才选择性地扩展技能库。 在推理过程中，系统动态检索最相关的情绪技能以强化边界感知推理，同时保持多模态大语言模型（MLLM）骨干冻结不变。 通过这种方式，CASE 将情感专业知识外化为模块化知识，这些知识独立于模型参数而演化，并可在不同的冻结 MLLM 骨干之间轻松复用。

paragraphs.en: We introduce CASE, which reframes MER from global multiclass classification toward selective discrimination on ambiguous fine-grained emotion boundaries.

By contrasting recoverable failures with valid anchors and verifying candidate skill updates, CASE enables reliable, sparse skill evolution atop a frozen multimodal backbone.

paragraphs.en: Recent MLLM-based emotion research has expanded affective label spaces and multimodal evidence modeling ( Guo et al. 2025 ; Hu et al. 2025 ) . Emotion-specific architectures and instruction-tuning strategies further improve general emotion understanding ( Cheng et al. 2024 ; Lian et al. 2025a ; Yang et al. 2025 ; Li et al. 2025 ) , open-vocabulary formulations relax predefined emotion taxonomies ( Lian et al. 2025b ) , and retrieval-augmented methods introduce external context for compound-emotion reasoning ( Wen et al. 2025 ) . Conflict-aware methods additionally mitigate incongruent evidence through adaptive fusion or modality selection ( Wang et al. 2023 ; Yu et al. 2026 ) . Despite these advances, existing methods primarily optimize one-shot prediction and rarely address recurrent errors between confusable emotion categories ( Han et al. 2025 ; Hu et al. 2025 ) . In this paper, CASE instead treats such errors as local decision-boundary failures. It uses pair-specific external knowledge to refine these boundaries while keeping the underlying MLLM frozen.
paragraphs.zh: 近期基于多模态大语言模型的情感研究扩展了情感标签空间和多模态证据建模（Guo et al. 2025；Hu et al. 2025）。 情感专用架构与指令微调策略进一步提升了通用的情感理解能力（Cheng et al. 2024；Lian et al. 2025a；Yang et al. 2025；Li et al. 2025），开放词表式的表述放宽了预定义的情感分类体系（Lian et al. 2025b），检索增强方法则为复合情感推理引入了外部上下文（Wen et al. 2025）。 冲突感知方法还通过自适应融合或模态选择来缓解不一致的证据（Wang et al. 2023；Yu et al. 2026）。 尽管有这些进展，现有方法主要优化一次性预测，很少处理易混淆情感类别之间的重复性错误（Han et al. 2025；Hu et al. 2025）。 在本文中，CASE 反而将此类错误视为局部的决策边界失效问题。 它利用成对特定的外部知识来修正这些边界，同时保持底层多模态大语言模型冻结不变。

sents.zh: 情感专用架构与指令微调策略进一步提升了通用的情感理解能力（Cheng et al. 2024；Lian et al. 2025a；Yang et al. 2025；Li et al. 2025），开放词表式的表述放宽了预定义的情感分类体系（Lian et al. 2025b），检索增强方法则为复合情感推理引入了外部上下文（Wen et al. 2025）。

sents.en: Conflict-aware methods additionally mitigate incongruent evidence through adaptive fusion or modality selection ( Wang et al. 2023 ; Yu et al. 2026 ) .

sents.en: Despite these advances, existing methods primarily optimize one-shot prediction and rarely address recurrent errors between confusable emotion categories ( Han et al. 2025 ; Hu et al. 2025 ) .
sents.zh: 尽管有这些进展，现有方法主要优化一次性预测，很少处理易混淆情感类别之间的重复性错误（Han et al. 2025；Hu et al. 2025）。

sents.en: In this paper, CASE instead treats such errors as local decision-boundary failures.
sents.zh: 在本文中，CASE 反而将此类错误视为局部的决策边界失效问题。

sents.en: It uses pair-specific external knowledge to refine these boundaries while keeping the underlying MLLM frozen.
sents.zh: 它利用成对特定的外部知识来修正这些边界，同时保持底层多模态大语言模型冻结不变。

paragraphs.en: Non-parametric learning methods differ in how they represent and reuse experience. Memory-based approaches retrieve previous examples or feedback ( Madaan et al. 2022 ) , whereas reflection-based agents retain verbal summaries of past interactions ( Shinn et al. 2023 ; Park et al. 2023 ) . Iterative self-feedback can refine individual outputs without additional training ( Madaan et al. 2023 ) , while prompt evolution adapts reusable task instructions through performance-guided search ( Fernando et al. 2024 ) . More recent methods distill experience into reusable instructions, workflows, toolboxes, or executable skills ( Wang et al. 2024a ; Zhao et al. 2024 ; Fu et al. 2024 ; Wang et al. 2024b ; Wang et al. 2025 ) , with persistent skill libraries supporting continual refinement and verifier-guided evolution ( Wang et al. 2026 ; Zhou et al. 2026 ; Zhang et al. 2026 ; Suzgun et al. 2026 ) . CASE adapts this paradigm to multimodal emotion recognition. Each EmotionSkill captures discriminative cues for one confusable emotion pair, is selectively activated by the model’s top-2 predictions, and is retained only when it improves the corresponding local decision boundary.
paragraphs.zh: 非参数化学习方法在表示和复用经验的方式上各不相同。 基于记忆的方法会检索先前的样例或反馈（Madaan et al. 2022），而基于反思的智能体则保留以往交互的言语化摘要（Shinn et al. 2023；Park et al. 2023）。 迭代式自我反馈可以在无需额外训练的情况下改进单个输出（Madaan et al. 2023），而提示词演化则通过性能引导的搜索来调整可复用的任务指令（Fernando et al. 2024）。 更新的方法将经验提炼为可复用的指令、工作流、工具箱或可执行技能（Wang et al. 2024a；Zhao et al. 2024；Fu et al. 2024；Wang et al. 2024b；Wang et al. 2025），持久化的技能库支持持续改进和验证器引导的演化（Wang et al. 2026；Zhou et al. 2026；Zhang et al. 2026；Suzgun et al. 2026）。 CASE 将这一范式应用于多模态情绪识别。 每个 EmotionSkill 捕捉某一易混淆情绪对的判别性线索，由模型的 top-2 预测选择性地激活，并且只有在其能改进相应的局部决策边界时才会被保留。

paragraphs.en: The errors addressed by CASE are not caused by a complete lack of emotion knowledge. Instead, the MLLM often identifies two plausible emotions but fails to apply the appropriate criterion for distinguishing them. In such cases, reconsidering all K K emotion labels introduces unnecessary alternatives rather than resolving ambiguous emotion boundaries.
paragraphs.zh: CASE 所解决的错误并非源于完全缺乏情绪知识。 相反，多模态大语言模型往往能识别出两种合理的情绪，却未能运用恰当的标准来区分它们。 在这种情况下，重新考虑全部 K 个情绪标签会引入不必要的备选项，而不是解决模糊的情绪边界问题。

paragraphs.en: Validated skill update. A candidate EmotionSkill revision is not activated immediately, since a textually plausible rule may still overcorrect the targeted failures or bias the pairwise prediction toward one emotion. CASE therefore evaluates the current and candidate EmotionSkills on the same fixed pair-specific validation subset. paragraphs.en: Sparse skill expansion. The missing-pair path in Figure 2 handles routed boundaries that are not yet covered by the active library. paragraphs.en: We evaluate CASE across three complementary settings: cross-modal emotion conflicts on CA-MER ( Han et al. 2025 ) , in-the-wild dynamic facial expression recognition on DFEW ( Jiang et al. 2020 ) , and fine-grained multimodal emotion reasoning on EMER ( Lian et al. 2023 ) . CA-MER contains the Audio-Conflict, Visual-Conflict, and Consistent subsets, for which we report accuracy (Acc.). For DFEW, we report unweighted average recall (UAR) and weighted average recall (WAR), while accuracy is used for EMER.

paragraphs.en: We first examine the in-distribution effectiveness of CASE on DFEW, where the skill library is constructed. We then evaluate CASE on CA-MER, a benchmark specifically designed to assess emotion recognition under conflicting multimodal cues. Finally, we evaluate CASE on the open-set EMER benchmark, which requires fine-grained emotion reasoning beyond a fixed closed-set label space.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先在构建技能库的 DFEW 数据集上检验 CASE 的分布内有效性。 然后我们在 CA-MER 上评估 CASE，该基准专门用于评估冲突多模态线索下的情绪识别。 最后，我们在开放集基准 EMER 上评估 CASE，该基准要求在固定闭集标签空间之外进行细粒度的情绪推理。

paragraphs.en: CA-MER’s conflicting multimodal cues naturally induce local emotion-boundary ambiguity, making it well suited to CASE. As shown in Tables 1 and 3 , CASE-Full improves Qwen3-VL-8B from 46.80% to 59.13% and Gemini-3.5-Flash from 66.73% to 70.60%, while Emotion-Qwen benefits most from CASE-Retrieval. These results demonstrate the generalization of CASE across backbones and tasks. Complete accuracy, macro-recall, and averaged results for all backbones and CA-MER subsets are reported in Supplementary Sec. C.
paragraphs.zh: CA-MER 中相互冲突的多模态线索天然会引发局部情感边界歧义，因此非常适合使用 CASE。 如表 1 和表 3 所示，CASE-Full 将 Qwen3-VL-8B 的成绩从 46.80% 提升到 59.13%，将 Gemini-3.5-Flash 从 66.73% 提升到 70.60%，而 Emotion-Qwen 则从 CASE-Retrieval 中获益最多。 这些结果证明了 CASE 在不同骨干模型和任务上的泛化能力。 所有骨干模型和 CA-MER 子集的完整准确率、宏召回率及平均结果见补充材料第 C 节。

paragraphs.en: On open-vocabulary EMER (Figure 4 ), CASE improves all three frozen backbones, with CASE-Retrieval consistently outperforming CASE-Full. Emotion-Qwen with CASE-Retrieval achieves 51.58%, surpassing prior methods and demonstrating effective cross-backbone transfer. Moreover, substantial gains over the backbones are observed for all three inference models, demonstrating that CASE generalizes effectively across backbones and open-set emotion reasoning settings.
paragraphs.zh: 在开放词表 EMER（图4）上，CASE 提升了全部三个冻结的骨干模型，其中 CASE-Retrieval 始终优于 CASE-Full。 配合 CASE-Retrieval 的 Emotion-Qwen 达到 51.58%，超越了以往方法，并展现出有效的跨骨干迁移能力。 此外，三种推理模型相较于其骨干模型均取得了显著提升，表明 CASE 能够在跨骨干和开放集合情感推理设置下有效泛化。

paragraphs.en: Among 114 candidate revisions, CASE accepts 10, rejecting 102 without validation gains and two causing label collapse. This low acceptance rate is intentional: the editor acts as a proposal generator rather than an authority that directly modifies the deployed system. The validation gate separates textual plausibility from behavioral utility and prevents unsupported or label-collapsing revisions from entering the active library. Thus, the purpose of the gate is not to maximize the number of accepted revisions, but to admit only behaviorally supported updates. Four new pairs pass the bootstrap gate, expanding coverage from 17 to 21 pairs and improving CA-MER accuracy from 58.27% to 59.13% in Table 4 . This demonstrates controlled skill updating and sparse expansion. Detailed acceptance dynamics, pair-specific validation changes, and expansion events are shown in Supplementary Sec. E.
paragraphs.zh: 在114个候选修订中，CASE接受10个，拒绝了102个未带来验证增益的修订，以及2个导致标签坍缩的修订。 这一低接受率是有意为之：编辑器充当的是提议生成器，而非直接修改已部署系统的权威。 验证门控将文本上的合理性与行为上的效用区分开来，并防止缺乏支持或导致标签坍缩的修订进入活动库。 因此，门控的目的不是最大化被接受修订的数量，而是只允许有行为支持的更新进入。 四个新配对通过了引导门控，将覆盖率从17个配对扩展到21个配对，并将表4中的CA-MER准确率从58.27%提升至59.13%。 这表明了受控的技能更新与稀疏扩展。 详细的接受动态、各配对的验证变化以及扩展事件见补充材料E节。

sents.en: Four new pairs pass the bootstrap gate, expanding coverage from 17 to 21 pairs and improving CA-MER accuracy from 58.27% to 59.13% in Table 4 .
sents.zh: 四个新配对通过了引导门控，将覆盖率从17个配对扩展到21个配对，并将表4中的CA-MER准确率从58.27%提升至59.13%。

sents.en: This demonstrates controlled skill updating and sparse expansion.
sents.zh: 这表明了受控的技能更新与稀疏扩展。

sents.en: Detailed acceptance dynamics, pair-specific validation changes, and expansion events are shown in Supplementary Sec. E.
sents.zh: 详细的接受动态、各配对的验证变化以及扩展事件见补充材料E节。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we introduced CASE, a confusion-aware framework for improving frozen MLLMs in multimodal emotion boundary discrimination. Rather than globally updating model parameters, CASE localizes ambiguous predictions to recurrent emotion-pair boundaries and selectively invokes pair-specific EmotionSkills for focused discrimination. Experiments across three emotion tasks and multiple backbones demonstrate consistent effectiveness and generality. These results highlight external skill evolution as a promising alternative to parameter-based adaptation for multimodal emotion understanding.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了CASE，一个面向提升冻结多模态大语言模型在多模态情感边界判别能力的混淆感知框架。 CASE不进行全局的模型参数更新，而是将模糊的预测定位到反复出现的情感对边界，并选择性地调用针对特定情感对的EmotionSkills进行聚焦判别。 在三个情感任务和多种骨干模型上的实验验证了一致的有效性和通用性。 这些结果凸显了外部技能演化作为基于参数的自适应方法之外的一种有前景的多模态情感理解替代方案。
